title: Микроскопические препараты: [Описание]
citation: Максимилиан Перти, Микроскопические препараты: [Описание], пер. с нем. Ю. Людевич, тетр. 1–5 (Санкт-Петербург: В. Генкель, 1855).
tags: Russia; microscopic preparations; preparation text; translation; St Petersburg; 1850s
note: A five-fascicle Russian-language publication devoted explicitly to microscopic preparations. The Russian State Library records it as a translation from German by Yu. Lyudevich, with separate title pages and pagination for each fascicle. It is admitted as a direct preparation text rather than as a general microscopy manual.

title: Nobert's test plate, Moller's diatom type slide, and modern microscopes
citation: Francis Abbott, “Nobert's Test Plate, Moller's Diatom Type Slide, and Modern Microscopes,” Monthly Notices of Papers & Proceedings of the Royal Society of Tasmania (1869): 35–41.
tags: Tasmania; Australia; Nobert; Möller; test plate; diatoms; objective testing; physical slides
note: A colonial Australian paper centred on two physical test-slide objects—Nobert's ruled test plate and Möller's diatom type slide—and their use in evaluating microscope objectives. The University of Tasmania repository supplies the original paper and identifies the test objects as the basis of the discussion.

title: Programma da cadeira de histologia e de physiologia geral da Universidade de Coimbra para o anno lectivo de 1872–73, e Catalogo da collecção de preparações microscopicas e dos apparelhos de physiologia experimental desta cadeira: 92 gravuras originaes

A. da Costa Simões, Programma da cadeira de histologia e de physiologia geral da Universidade de Coimbra para o anno lectivo de 1872–73, e Catalogo da collecção de preparações microscopicas e dos apparelhos de physiologia experimental desta cadeira: 92 gravuras originaes (Coimbra: Imprensa da Universidade, 1873).
tags: Portugal; Coimbra; histology; teaching collection; microscope preparations; catalogue; physiology
note: A Portuguese-language catalogue of the University of Coimbra teaching collection, bound with the 1872–73 histology and general-physiology course programme. The publication explicitly contains a catalogue of the collection of microscopic preparations and experimental-physiology apparatus; it is admitted for that collection-catalogue component rather than for the broader course programme.

title: Diatoms: notes on their collection cleaning and mounting
citation: H. J. Grayson, “Diatoms: Notes on Their Collection, Cleaning and Mounting,” Victorian Naturalist 9, no. 7 (1892): 102–111.
tags: Australia; Melbourne; diatoms; slide making; cleaning; mounting; H.J. Grayson
note: A Melbourne microscopist's own technical paper on collecting, cleaning and mounting diatoms. Grayson's skill in preparing biological and geological microscope slides is independently documented in Australian historical reference sources, making this a direct maker-practice source rather than a generic diatom paper.
links: Encyclopedia of Australian Science and Innovation: https://www.eoas.info/biogs/P001250b.htm; Australian Dictionary of Biography: https://adb.anu.edu.au/biography/grayson-henry-joseph-6466

title: Note on microscopical test rulings
citation: H. J. Grayson, “Note on Microscopical Test Rulings,” Victorian Naturalist 11, no. 12 (1895): 163–164.
tags: Australia; Melbourne; test plates; micro-rulings; objective testing; H.J. Grayson; surviving slides
note: A direct maker note on microscopic test rulings produced as glass test plates. Surviving Grayson plates at the University of Melbourne's Ed Muirhead Physics Museum and the Smithsonian retain labels specifying ruled bands up to 120,000 lines per inch, closing the printed source to identifiable physical slide objects.
links: Encyclopedia of Australian Science and Innovation: https://www.eoas.info/biogs/P001250b.htm; Victorian Collections: https://victoriancollections.net.au/items/59afe14921ea711838038c62; Smithsonian National Museum of American History: https://americanhistory.si.edu/collections/object/nmah_1368100

title: 顕微鏡的検査、病原的黴菌プレパラート頒布
citation: 東京顕微鏡院, 「顕微鏡的検査、病原的黴菌プレパラート頒布」, 『顕微鏡』第3号 (1895).
tags: Japan; Tokyo; bacteriology; prepared slides; distribution; advertisement; Meiji
note: An 1895 advertisement explicitly offering the distribution (頒布) of prepared slides of pathogenic microbes alongside microscopic examination services. The Tōyama Tsubakikichi Memorial Museum reproduces the advertisement and identifies the original as issue no. 3 of Kenbikyō, held by the National Diet Library.

title: Colección helmintológica del Museo de La Plata: I. Catálogo de preparaciones microscópicas material tipo y no tipo
citation: Carola Ana Sutton de Licitra and María Cristina Damborenea, “Colección helmintológica del Museo de La Plata: I. Catálogo de preparaciones microscópicas, material tipo y no tipo,” Serie Técnica y Didáctica Museo de La Plata, no. 35 (2000): 1–20.
tags: Argentina; La Plata; helminths; microscope slides; catalogue; type specimens; museum collection; provenance
note: A slide-first catalogue of the Museo de La Plata helminthological collection. It records microscope-slide material for 106 helminth species with registration number, type status, host, localization and locality, making the physical slide register the publication's core evidence.
